title: Korean Central Presbytery — Citation regarding Assignment from GA/Review of Presbytery Records
disposition_detail: The SJC accepted Korean Central Presbytery’s response to exceptions of substance, conditional upon certification to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records that Presbytery had approved the response.
first_summary: Cited under BCO 40-5 concerning exceptions of substance in its records, Korean Central Presbytery submitted a response that the SJC found acceptable. The response resolved the citation, subject to certification that Presbytery had approved it.
summary: Cited under BCO 40-5 to provide a more acceptable response to exceptions of substance in its records, Korean Central Presbytery submitted a response that the SJC accepted, pending certification to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records that Presbytery had approved it. The ruling accepted the response conditionally; it did not substantively approve the underlying records.

sources.supports: Case identity, collective adoption, BCO 40-5 citation, exceptions of substance, response, conditional acceptance, and certification requirement.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Lines 13–15 identify 2010-19 as Korean Central Presbytery; lines 33 and 55–59 show collective consideration and adoption by the SJC.
evidence_notes.dispute: Printed p. 602, lines 37–47 states that the BCO 40-5 citation sought a more acceptable response to deficiencies and identifies Korean Central’s deficiencies as exceptions of substance.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Printed p. 602, lines 49–53 records the response and finds it acceptable, pending certification that Presbytery approved it.
evidence_notes.qualifications: Acceptance was conditional on certification; the source does not describe the substantive exceptions or approve the underlying records (lines 51–53).
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No decision is incorporated by reference.

source_limits: The decision treats six citations collectively and provides no details about Korean Central Presbytery’s substantive exceptions or response beyond conditional acceptance.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the BCO 40-5 citation and exceptions of substance.
score_reasons.decision: States conditional acceptance and the required certification.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Faithfully reports that the response was acceptable without inventing substantive reasoning.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Distinguishes acceptance of the response from approval of the underlying records.
score_reasons.fidelity: Keeps the citation, SJC finding, and condition distinct.
score_reasons.economy: Includes only facts needed to explain the issue, outcome, and limitation.

verification_notes: Rechecked lines 37–53 to confirm that Korean Central faced exceptions of substance, that only its response was accepted, and that acceptance remained pending certification; removed any implication that its minutes were forwarded, because line 53 names only three other presbyteries.
